analytics.title: Analytics Dashboards
analytics.problem: Data is scattered across systems. Building reports takes days. Insights come too late to act on.
analytics.solution: AI-powered dashboards aggregate data in real-time, answer questions in natural language, and surface insights automatically.

compliance.title: Compliance Tracking
compliance.problem: Manual compliance checks are error-prone. Regulations change frequently. Audit trails are incomplete.
compliance.solution: AI monitors activities 24/7, flags violations instantly, maintains complete audit logs, and adapts to regulatory changes.

quality.title: Quality Assurance
quality.problem: Quality issues discovered after production. Manual inspection is slow and inconsistent. Root causes unclear.
quality.solution: AI inspects 100% of output in real-time, identifies defects instantly, tracks trends, and recommends corrective actions.

monitoring.title: Process Monitoring
monitoring.problem: Critical processes run blind. Issues escalate before detection. Performance bottlenecks are hidden.
monitoring.solution: AI monitors all processes 24/7, predicts failures before they occur, and optimizes performance automatically.
